title: Provisional and Final Dispute Credits on Northgate Card Accounts
content:
**Credit on opening.** On a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** card that posts a provisional credit when a dispute is opened, the disputed amount is credited provisionally when the dispute is opened; on a card that does not, the disputed amount is only set aside under the billing-error dispute rules and no credit posts until resolution.

**Account status.** A dispute credit can be posted only on an account in active, suspended or closed status, as the system record of the card account shows it.

| Account status | Dispute credit can post |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| suspended | yes |
| closed | yes |
| applied, charged off or declined | no |

**Resolution for the cardholder — clause no longer in force.** The clause "when a dispute is resolved for the cardholder, a provisional credit becomes final with no further posting, and on a tier without provisional credit a final credit of the disputed amount posts" is **no longer in force** as written here. It is superseded by the current basis for final credits on disputes resolved for the cardholder.

**Resolution for the merchant.** When it is resolved for the merchant, any provisional credit is reversed, and interest that would have accrued on the disputed amount while it was set aside is charged on the next statement as reinstated dispute interest; the cardholder is given at least the grace period of the card's payment-due days after close before a late fee can arise on that amount.

**Withdrawn disputes.** A withdrawn dispute is treated like one resolved for the merchant, except that when it was withdrawn because the merchant credited the transaction, the provisional credit is reversed against the merchant credit and no interest is reinstated.

**Unauthorized charges.** Unauthorized charges are always credited in full because cardholder liability for unauthorized use is 0.00 USD.

| Outcome | Provisional credit (where posted) | Interest on the set-aside amount |
|---|---|---|
| resolved for the merchant | reversed | charged on the next statement as reinstated dispute interest |
| withdrawn by the cardholder | reversed | charged on the next statement as reinstated dispute interest |
| withdrawn because the merchant credited the transaction | reversed against the merchant credit | not reinstated |

superseded_clauses: When a dispute is resolved for the cardholder, a provisional credit becomes final with no further posting, and on a tier without provisional credit a final credit of the disputed amount posts.
